about: denyUrls / allowUrls cases every SDK runs (the JavaScript SDK's meaning, packages/sdk/src/event-filter.ts). frame is the file, path, module path or URL of the error's top stack frame (the innermost one, where it was raised), or null when it has none. A pattern is { "string": s } (dropped when the frame contains s; an empty string is ignored) or { "regex": r } (dropped when r finds a match anywhere in the frame, as a search, not a full match; the regexes use only syntax every SDK's engine shares). deny wins over allow; a non-empty allow list drops a frame none of its patterns match; an error without a frame is kept. drop is the reason the error is dropped (deny_urls or allow_urls), or null to keep it. Hand-written; tests/sdk-url-filters.test.ts checks the JavaScript SDK agrees. Copied into each SDK by generate.sh.
